title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.29 - Fixes a bug in 0.1.28 that stopped cards being playable on older versions of the game. The card's energy was spent and the card then hung on the stack doing nothing, because the meter read a property of a card play that older builds do not have, and it read it on the path every single card takes. The meter now takes the same value off the card itself, which works on every supported version. Nothing else changed - the credit for a card you make for a teammate, new in 0.1.28, works as it did. Verified on game v0.111.0, and this release is compiled against v0.107.1 as well, which is the check that was missing.
